items.title: Historical Haunts — ghost walk of downtown Waynesville
items.venue: Downtown Waynesville (Museum at the Friends Home)
items.note: Two-hour guided walking tour of the historic district drawing on the village’s 228-year history, run by the Museum at the Friends Home. The museum also runs a $60 Ghost & Goblet dinner and tour at The Venue at the Historic Lockup, and a $50 Ghost Hunting 101 class with ParaVizionz. Check the museum's booking page for tour times.

items.title: Windmill Farm Market Spooktacular
items.venue: Windmill Farm Market, 1454 E State Route 73, Springboro
items.note: Fall festival at Windmill Farm Market, on SR 73 a short drive east of the village, promoted on the Waynesville Merchant Association calendar. Check the market's website for daily hours.

items.title: Waynesville Fall Fest
items.note: Corn maze, mini golf, petting farm, and other fall activities; $16 adult / $14 ages 10 & under daily admission. Not affiliated with Hisey Fall Fest.

items.title: Bourbon & Cigars: An Evening in Waynesville (Chamber Mixer)
items.venue: Villager Pub, 144 S. Main St, Waynesville
items.note: The Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce's October networking mixer: bourbon, cigars and good company. Open to everyone — Chamber members, non-members and friends welcome.

items.title: Ohio Renaissance Festival — Heroes and Villains Weekend
items.note: Closing weekend of the 2026 season.

items.title: Village Trick or Treat
items.note: Official village-wide trick-or-treat hours, per the Village's events calendar. Separate from the downtown shops' Trick or Treat stroll on Sun, Oct 25.

items.title: Waynesville Fantasy Festival
items.note: Third annual free, family-friendly celebration of all things fantasy: LARP training grounds and an archery contest, birds-of-prey encounters, a fire performance, live music, a cosplay competition, riddle trivia, a halfling tea party, a walking-staff competition, a quest, and a beer garden. Check the festival listing for the day's schedule.

items.title: Business to Business Networking — November
items.note: Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce Business to Business networking mixer. Check the Chamber events page for details.

items.title: Little Miami Scenic Trail
items.note: ~78-mi paved rail-trail — biking, hiking, running

items.title: Kings Island
items.dateLabel: Thu–Sun through Nov 1; Nov 7–8; WinterFest select nights Nov 27–Dec 31
items.note: Park hours: Halloween Haunt season Thu 6–11 PM, Fri 6 PM–midnight, Sat 11 AM–midnight, Sun 11 AM–11 PM, closed Mon–Wed; Tricks and Treats Sat–Sun 11 AM–5 PM. Nov 1 and the Nov 7–8 Bonus Weekend 11 AM–7 PM. WinterFest opens Nov 27 (Nov 27 & 29 5–10 PM, Nov 28 4–10 PM) and runs select nights through Dec 31. Waterpark closed. Check the park calendar for any changes.

items.title: WinterFest at Kings Island
items.note: Per Kings Island: holiday event on select nights. Opening weekend hours Nov 27 & 29 5–10 PM, Nov 28 4–10 PM. December open dates on the park calendar: Dec 4–6, 11–23 and 26–31; check the calendar for each night's hours.

items.title: Wayne Local Schools Board of Education — Regular Meeting & Spartan Recognition Awards
items.venue: WLS Performing Arts Center (Auditorium), 625 Dayton Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Per Wayne Local Board Meeting Recap (Oct 2026): the bi-annual Spartan Recognition Awards ceremony opens the meeting, followed by a short break and the regular business meeting. Open to the public.

items.title: Halloween Haunt at Kings Island
items.venue: Kings Island, 6300 Kings Island Dr, Mason
items.note: Select nights Thursday through Sunday. Per Kings Island, not recommended for children under 13, and every guest needs paid admission. Check the park calendar for nightly hours.

items.title: Trick or Treat at Ohio Living Quaker Heights
items.venue: Ohio Living Quaker Heights, 514 High St, Waynesville
items.note: Open to the community: kids walk through the building while residents pass out candy.

items.title: Gingerbread 101 Workshop
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: The Waynesville Area Arts Council hosts a gingerbread-making workshop at the library. Register in person at the library; a cash deposit ($10 per person, or $20 for a group of 2–4) is collected at sign-up and refunded at the workshop. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

items.title: Christmas in the Village
items.note: Fri 1–9 PM (shops open 11 AM), Sat noon–8 PM, Sun 11 AM–4 PM. Santa arrives by fire truck at the Gazebo on Main Street (Fri 6 PM, Sat 1 PM); heated entertainment tent and strolling characters; Sunday Holiday Christmas Market Street Faire with the Parade of Santas at 1 PM.

items.title: Waynesville High School Swim Team — Athlete/Parent Meeting
items.note: For Waynesville High School swimmers and their parents, per the team's flyer. Contact the high school with questions.

items.title: Warren County Career Center Information Night (grades 9–10)
items.note: For WHS students in grades 9 and 10 and their parents: meet the Warren County Career Center team and learn about career-tech programs.

items.title: North Warren County Transportation Plan — Public Open House
items.venue: Warren County Career Center, 3525 S.R. 48, Lebanon
items.note: Drop in anytime to see options for a possible new connection between I-75 and I-71 and 10 priority road improvement locations across northern Warren County, including Waynesville and Wayne Township. Hosted by the Warren County Engineer's Office and Transportation Improvement District. Can't make it? The same materials and a comment survey are on the project website through Nov 17.

items.title: Christmas Book Flood PJ Storytime
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: An evening storytime for all ages, in pajamas, celebrating Iceland's "Jolabokaflod" (Christmas Book Flood) tradition. Children take home a book and a hot cocoa packet. No registration required.

items.title: Service Dog Storytime
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Stories about service dogs, plus a chance to meet a working service dog and its handler.

items.title: Friends of the Library Holiday Auction
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Bid in person on holiday decorations and gift baskets donated by area businesses and community groups. Bidding opens Friday, Nov 20 at noon and closes Thursday, Dec 10 at 7:00 PM. To donate an item, contact the library.

items.title: Letters to Santa mailbox at the library
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Drop letters to Santa in the library's special mailbox. Letters mailed by Dec 15 get a reply from Santa's elves, who try to answer before Dec 25.

items.title: Santa Holiday Open House at the Library
items.venue: Mary L. Cook Public Library, 381 Old Stage Rd, Waynesville
items.note: Photos with Santa, letter writing, a holiday craft, the library's new Elf Academy, and refreshments from the Friends of the Library. Registration required, beginning Monday, Nov 9: call the library at 513-897-4826 or sign up at the front desk.

items.dateLabel: Fri–Sun, Nov 6–8 · Fri & Sat 11 AM–8 PM, Sun noon–5 PM
items.note: Holiday open house weekend in the downtown shops; collect recipe cards as you stroll from shop to shop. Free admission.

items.title: Waynesville Town Square Days
items.note: A downtown weekend on the Waynesville Merchant Association calendar. Check the event page for hours and details.

items.title: Waynesville Christmas Rewind
items.note: A nostalgic Christmas evening downtown: shop local for last-minute gifts, hot cocoa, Christmas music and classic-Christmas-movie fun. Free, no tickets needed.

items.title: Free Thanksgiving food baskets for Waynesville families
items.note: MorningStar Baptist Church is offering Thanksgiving food baskets to Waynesville families who could use a little extra help this year. To ask for one for yourself or someone you know, text 937-270-2330, email Outreach@morningstardayton.org or message the church on Facebook.
